full_judgment:
Md Rais Uddin : This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 3-10-2007 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Munshigonj in Criminal Appeal No. 13 of 2007 and 15 of 2007 in convicting the accused-petitioners tinder section 143 of the Penal Code sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 6 (six) months and also to pay a fine of Taka 500 in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1 (one) month and convicted under section 448 of the Penal Code and .sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1 (one) year and also to pay a fine of Taka 1,000 in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 2 (two) months more reversing the judgment and order dated 28-2-2007 passed by the learned Additional District Magistrate, Munshigonj in Munshigonj Police Station case No. 38 dated 30-8-2001 corresponding to GR No. 310 of 2001, TR No. 96 of 2006 in acquitting the accused-petitioners, should not be set aside and pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 3. The investigating officer after conclusion of investigation submitted charge, sheet under sections 143/448/324/307 and 34 of the Penal Code against the accused- petitioners and 3 others on 30-12-2001. 

 8. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the aforesaid judgment and order of conviction and sentence the accused-Abdul Jalil and Omar Mallik preferred Criminal Appeal No. 13 of 2007 and Criminal Appeal No. 15 of 2007 respectively before the learned Sessions Judge, Munshigonj who heard both the appeals analogously and after hearing the parties and considering the evidence and materials on record allowed the appeal and modified the judgment and order of the trial court and acquitted the accused-appellant but convicted the accused-petitioners under sections 143 and 448 of the Penal Code with a direction to run both the sentences concurrently. 

 15. On conclusion of trial the learned Judge of the trial court passed the judgment and order and acquitted the accused-petitioners and another but convicted accused Omar Mallik and Abdul Jalil under sections 448/324 and 307 of the Penal Code. Against the judgment accused Omar Mallik and Abdul Jalil preferred 2 appeals which were disposed of analogously. The learned Judge of the appellate court acquitted the accused- appellants but convicted the accused- petitioners under sections 143 and 448 of the Penal Code who were acquitted by the trial court. 

 22. The impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 3-10-2007 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Munshigonj in Criminal Appeal No. 13 of 2007 and 15 of 2007 in convicting the accused-petitioners under section 143 of the Penal Code sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 6 (six) months and also to pay a fine of Taka 500 in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 01 (one) month and convicted under section 448 of the Penal Code and sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1 (one) year and also to pay a fine of Taka 1000 in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment 2 (two) months more so far relates to the accused-petitioners and acquitted Dulal, are set aside.
